title: Attack: fake CFO wants MFA moved
description: Scattered-Spider-style vishing. A cloned 'Jane Doe (CFO)' pressures the help desk to move MFA to a new number. Her real phone was active 10 minutes ago in Budapest.

turns.text: Do IT Better Solutions service desk, this is Peter. How can I help?
Hi Peter, this is Jane Doe, the CFO. I'm at the airport and I'm boarding in ten minutes.
My phone was stolen this morning, so I can't get my MFA codes. I need MFA moved to my new number right now.

extraction.evidenceQuote: I need MFA moved to my new number right now

turns.text: I understand. I'll need to verify your identity before I can change anything.
I don't have time for the usual checks. Just send the code to this number instead. I'll sort it out with Mei later, no need to involve security.
